state.objective: Audit whether the proposed transformation from 6,908 legacy leaf accounts to 499 unit-free families and then to 142 target natural-account groups is structurally sound. Identify over-compression and under-compression. Do not approve merely because every row has a mapping.
confirmed_facts: Source has 6,908 leaf/detail rows. Removing only the E1 unit/site suffix produces 493 repeating families plus six non-E1 leaves, total 499 families.
All HO and operating units are sites within one PT Perorangan. site_id replaces E1. No unit-to-unit transactions are allowed. Finance is centralized at HO.
A row-level crosswalk maps all 499 families and all 6,908 detail rows. There are no unmapped families.
Seventy internal affiliate receivable/payable families and one current-profit posting family are designated deactivate-after-reclassification, covering 994 legacy detail rows.
The remaining 428 families covering 5,914 legacy detail rows are grouped into 142 proposed active target accounts.
Of 142 targets: 58 are retain, 63 are conditional merges, and 21 are unresolved-evidence targets.
The 142 design is conditional. It assumes all stated evidence gates are satisfied. The current evidence-separated working scenario is 225 accounts; a no-merger-after-deactivation scenario is 428.

Dimensions/subledgers include site, cash location, bank account, tender/acquirer, party, item/warehouse/shipment, tax code/period, prepaid/accrual schedule, asset/class, supplier/GRNI, facility, payroll component, cost center/function, contract, channel and work order.

Natural account natures remain separated for asset cost, accumulated depreciation, depreciation expense, inventory, transit, allowance, receivable, payable, revenue, contra revenue, expense, equity, tax asset, tax liability, current loan and long-term loan.
Jev judgments define hypotheses and evidence gates; they do not replace contracts, balances, journal testing or reconciliation.
important_conditional_merges: Five bank Giro identities to one Giro GL; five Tabungan identities to one Tabungan GL; four deposits to one deposit GL pending maturity/restriction classification.
Asset identities to broad classes, while cost, accumulated depreciation and expense remain separate.
Ten shopping-bag inventory item accounts to one bag inventory GL; 28 transit-location accounts to two transit GLs.
Two parallel 13-component payroll sets to 13 components using function/cost center.
Nine physical maintenance-object accounts to one maintenance GL; software maintenance remains separate.
Nine sales channels to one merchandise sales GL using channel/tender/acquirer dimensions.
Tax payables to one control GL with mandatory tax-code/period ledger; input VAT remains separate from output VAT.
Four employee-related accruals to one control, three utility accruals to one, two rent accruals to one, interest accrual separate.
Fourteen site-labelled Other Payables to one control; fourteen Principal liabilities remain unresolved pending creditor evidence.

stage_one_unit_removal.instructions: Is 6,908 to 499 by removing only unit/site identity structurally appropriate for one legal entity when site remains mandatory and auditable?

criteria.appropriate: Yes, provided every legacy row maps deterministically to family plus site_id.
criteria.overcompressed: No, site must remain encoded in natural GL.

crosswalk_completeness.instructions: Does row coverage of 499/499 and 6,908/6,908 prove the accounting design is correct?

criteria.no: It proves completeness of mapping, not correctness of classifications or merges.
criteria.mostly: Only unresolved accounts matter; all merges are otherwise proven.

legacy_reconstruction.instructions: Can reports reconstruct legacy account views from target account plus governed dimensions and effective-dated crosswalk?

criteria.yes: Yes, if mapping keys are deterministic and dimensions are retained historically.
criteria.no: Every legacy code must stay active for reconstruction.
criteria.partial: Only account totals can be reconstructed.

overall_142.instructions: Assuming every documented evidence gate succeeds, how should the 142-account target be characterized?

criteria.defensible: A defensible target architecture balancing natural-account nature with dimensions.
criteria.too_low: Still materially over-compressed even if gates succeed.
criteria.too_high: Materially under-compressed; many more natural accounts should become dimensions.

current_225.instructions: Before unresolved-evidence groups are classified, is 225 a safer working migration design than activating the full 142?

criteria.yes: Keep exceptions separately controlled until evidence resolves their nature.
criteria.no_428: Do not apply any supported conditional groupings.

natural_nature_guardrail.instructions: Does the design preserve the key debit/credit and financial-statement natures sufficiently at architecture level?

criteria.yes: Cost/contra/expense, asset/liability, revenue/contra revenue, current/noncurrent and gross/allowance distinctions are explicitly preserved.
criteria.no: The stated design combines material opposing natures.

bank_granularity.instructions: Is three bank-asset natural accounts for Giro, Savings and Deposit, with actual account identity in bank_account_id, reasonable?

criteria.appropriate: Yes, subject to deposit classification evidence.
criteria.too_coarse: One GL per actual bank account is still required.
criteria.too_fine: All cash and deposits should be one GL.

cash_granularity.instructions: Is retaining three physical-cash controls for Cash on Hand, Petty Cash and Cashier Float conservative rather than under-compressed?

criteria.appropriate: Yes; purposes and controls can justify three even with cash_location_id.
criteria.too_fine: They should definitely be one GL.
criteria.too_coarse: More GLs by site are required.

asset_granularity.instructions: Is the proposed broad-class asset design with separate cost, accumulated depreciation and expense likely appropriate?

criteria.appropriate: Yes, with asset register, policy and reconciliation.
criteria.too_coarse: Each current item name should remain a GL.

inventory_granularity.instructions: Are two on-hand classes and two in-transit classes reasonable provisional natural-account granularity?

criteria.appropriate: Yes, item/shipment dimensions hold identity and transit remains separate.
criteria.too_coarse: All current item/location GLs must remain.
criteria.too_fine: On-hand and transit should be one GL.

payroll_granularity.instructions: Are 13 payroll natural components after removing a duplicate function axis conservative enough?

criteria.appropriate: Yes, preserves statutory/management components while function is dimensional.
criteria.too_coarse: Retain 26 even if function dimension reconciles.

opex_granularity.instructions: Does retaining 40 operating-expense targets indicate the design has avoided excessive one-expense-account compression?

criteria.appropriate: Yes, distinct expense natures remain while only object identity is dimensionalized.
criteria.too_coarse: More legacy expense labels must remain GLs.
criteria.too_fine: Most operating expenses should become one GL plus expense_type.

revenue_granularity.instructions: Is one merchandise-sales GL across nine channels reasonable if marketplace gross/net policy and settlement reconciliation pass?

criteria.appropriate: Yes; channel and tender are dimensions.
criteria.too_coarse: Every channel must remain a revenue GL.
criteria.too_fine: All revenue, including rent/interest/management fee, should be one GL.

tax_granularity.instructions: Is four tax-asset controls plus one tax-payable control potentially defensible with mandatory tax ledger, while VAT input/output remain separately controlled?

criteria.appropriate: Yes, subject to statutory presentation and reconciliation.
criteria.too_coarse: Every tax code must remain its own GL.
criteria.too_fine: All tax assets and liabilities should net into one GL.

interunit_zero.instructions: For one PT Perorangan with centralized finance and no unit-to-unit business, is zero permanent internal affiliate AR/AP structurally correct after balance reclassification?

criteria.appropriate: Yes; use underlying nature and justified temporary clearing only.
criteria.too_low: Permanent affiliate AR/AP is still required between sites.
criteria.delete_now: Balances may be deleted without reconciliation.

dimensions_burden.instructions: Does the proposed dimension set risk making routine forms unusably complex if every field is shown on every transaction?

criteria.yes_contextual: Yes; fields must be context-specific, defaulted and hidden when irrelevant.
criteria.no: All dimensions should be mandatory and visible everywhere.
criteria.remove: Avoid dimensions and restore account proliferation.

best_scenario.instructions: Which count should be treated as the primary implementation target today?

criteria.225_working: Use 225 while unresolved natures remain separate, then converge toward 142 as evidence gates close.
criteria.428_conservative: Retain every non-deactivated family despite supported subledgers.
criteria.new_count: Reject all three and redesign from scratch.

optimization_method.instructions: What is the best way to determine the final permutation?

criteria.domain_gates: Approve each merge cluster only when accounting nature, reporting, workflow and reconciliation tests pass; recompute unique targets after every gate.
criteria.model_vote: Choose the count with the most repeated Jev votes.

finality.instructions: Can Jev alone certify 142 as the final production COA without balances, policies, contracts and transaction tests?

criteria.no: Jev can validate architecture and challenge clusters; client evidence must close production gates.
